outbox_organization_id_key_index.name: outbox_organization_id_key_index
outbox_organization_id_key_index.where: "outbox"."key" is not null and "outbox"."done_at" is null and "outbox"."failed_at" is null

sales_document_organization_id_kind_numb.name: sales_document_organization_id_kind_number_index
sales_document_organization_id_kind_numb.where: "sales_document"."number" is not null and "sales_document"."deleted_at" is null

sales_document_invoice_check.name: sales_document_invoice_check
sales_document_invoice_check.value: "sales_document"."kind" <> 'invoice' or ("sales_document"."number" is not null and "sales_document"."issued_at" is not null)
